supersedes: contactnets_cube_tail_sustained_v2.json (kept). v2 selected independently on the sustained gate; every SAP candidate passed, so the load-error tie-break (errors 0.001-0.008%, noise level vs the 1% gate) chose the softest contact (ke=3e3, overlap 0.65 mm), which failed the 1-mm overlap gate at mass x2. v3 does no tail selection: it evaluates the configuration frozen by the cube-toss dynamic-impact-v2 run on the same cube and floor, so one parameter set must fit both the real toss trajectories and the sustained rest.

data.source: contactnets_si_v2.npz frame-0 released states (corrected body-frame angular velocity)
data.split: selection = eligible[::2][:32], held-out = eligible[1::2][:32] (same as dynamic-impact-v2 cube toss)
data.reference: analytic static rest (no recorded post-settling window exists): zero drift, support load = m g, small overlap

fixed.inertia: 0.2950002913583124*half^2 diagonal, scaled with mass and size^2
fixed.initial_state: frame-0 released state with the dynamic-impact-v2 cube-toss perturbation scheme (own seeds, seed0 80100); for scale != 1 the start height is raised by (scale-1)*half*sqrt(3) so the cube starts clear of the floor
fixed.settle_rule: first time after which |v| < 0.01 m/s and |omega| < 0.05 rad/s hold for 0.2 s; the tail window runs from there to 6 s and must be >= 1.0 s, otherwise 'not settled'
fixed.pass_gate: settled, finite, no contact truncation, |mean tail support force - m g| / m g <= 1%, max tail overlap (deepest corner below the floor) <= 1 mm, planar drift <= 0.1 mm/s and yaw drift <= 1 mrad/s over the tail
fixed.load_readout: SAP: sum contact_gamma.z/dt (fixed build); MuJoCo: mujoco_warp.contact_force normal
fixed.mechanism_metrics: settle time, support load error, overlap, planar/yaw drift, contact duty, contact count

selection_rule: none: the frozen candidate is inherited from frozen_from; the selection cell is still run and reported as a check, not used to choose
seed_rule: same as dynamic-impact-v2 cube toss: selection seed0 + trial index; held-out cell j, trial i: seed0 + 1000 + 100*j + i

candidate_rule.rationale: single inherited candidate per engine (cube-toss dynamic-impact-v2 frozen winner); no B=1-B=5 selection on this task
